mvpBoundary.included: Exact guarded restricted B08 chamber, dry containment receiver, shaft isolation collar, and retained return interfaces only.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: No public or emergency egress commissioning, B03/B09 opening, B09 receiver, rail/control action, or automated fluid discharge is authorized.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Complete canonical source/target states, package order, and exact reverse inverse.
Fresh immutable source and exact preflight immediately precede any mutation.
Forward and reverse strict-noop parser checks both pass.
Exact block/container and immediately-before-mutation live-entity clearances both pass.
Strict journalled execution retains a complete compensating inverse.
Fresh post capture, independent containment/normal/failure-route QA, and rollback post-state preflight pass.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: Failure blocks only this exact chamber/receiver package.
